title: Domains
description: Every hostname this server answers for.

empty.title: No domains yet
empty.description: Point a domain's DNS at {{ip}}, then add it here with the service it should reach.

dnsHint: DNS records must point at {{ip}}, with ports 80 and 443 open.

form.resolverHint: Empty uses Let's Encrypt over HTTP.
form.wildcardHint: Answers on every direct subdomain, and needs a DNS-challenge resolver.
form.stripPathHint: The destination receives the request without this path, so /api/users arrives as /users.
form.upstreamNameHint: The name on the upstream's certificate. Empty means the public hostname.
form.upstreamCaHint: A private CA, or the self-signed certificate itself, in PEM. Empty means public authorities only.
form.wildcardUnverified: HTTPS on a wildcard is not verified yet. It depends on your DNS-challenge resolver, and shows as working only once the proxy really holds the certificate.
form.lastServer: A rule needs at least one server.
form.serverUrlHint: An address this rule forwards to.
form.internalPathHint: Added in front of the path the service receives.
form.portHint: The port the service listens on.
form.destinationHint: Where the traffic for this domain goes.
form.pathHint: The part of the URL this rule answers, such as /api.
form.httpsHint: Serve this domain over HTTPS, with a certificate.
form.hostHint: The name visitors type, such as shop.example.com.

errors.service: Choose a project and a service.

prerequisites.title: Before this answers
prerequisites.dnsUnknown: A record for {{name}}, pointing at this server's address
prerequisites.certificateAuto: Issued automatically once DNS and port 80 are right.
prerequisites.certificateWildcard: Needs the DNS-challenge resolver named under SSL.
